item_short_desc: Featuring an oxide-coated carbon steel blade, this replica machete provides exceptional cutting power, while the flame-resistant thermoplastic handle ensures a secure and reliable grip. Equipped with a protective handguard, Rothco's 18 inch Field Machete is the perfect tool for outdoor survival, tactical missions, or clearing brush.
